<documents>
<document id="atm-surcharges">
ATMˆownerˆsurchargesˆandˆourˆfeesˆWhenˆyouˆuseˆanˆATMˆoutsideˆBrookLink,ˆupˆtoˆtwoˆdifferentˆchargesˆcanˆapply.ˆThey'reˆeasyˆtoˆmixˆup.ˆ##ˆTheˆATMˆowner'sˆsurchargeˆThisˆisˆsetˆbyˆwhoeverˆownsˆtheˆATM,ˆnotˆbyˆus.ˆTheˆATMˆshowsˆitˆonˆscreenˆbeforeˆyouˆconfirm,ˆandˆit'sˆaddedˆtoˆtheˆwithdrawalˆamount.ˆForˆexample,ˆifˆyouˆwithdrawˆcashˆandˆtheˆownerˆchargesˆaˆsurcharge,ˆoneˆtransactionˆforˆtheˆtotalˆappearsˆinˆyourˆactivity.ˆ##ˆTallowbrook'sˆout-of-networkˆfeeˆThisˆisˆourˆfee,ˆchargedˆasˆaˆseparateˆlineˆcalledˆ"Out-of-networkˆATMˆfee".ˆIt'sˆ$2.50ˆonˆBasicˆandˆonˆPlusˆafterˆyourˆfreeˆwithdrawals,ˆandˆfreeˆonˆPremium.ˆ##ˆPremiumˆsurchargeˆreimbursementˆPremiumˆpaysˆbackˆATMˆownerˆsurchargesˆupˆtoˆ$10.00ˆperˆcalendarˆmonth.ˆTheˆrefundˆisˆcreditedˆautomaticallyˆonˆtheˆfirstˆbusinessˆdayˆofˆtheˆnextˆmonth.ˆ##ˆAvoidingˆbothˆUseˆaˆBrookLinkˆATM.ˆTheyˆneverˆchargeˆaˆsurcharge,ˆandˆweˆneverˆchargeˆaˆfeeˆforˆthem.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="atm-fees-basic-v2">
ATMˆfeesˆonˆBasicˆHere'sˆwhatˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆcostˆonˆtheˆBasicˆplan.ˆ|ˆATMˆ|ˆTallowbrookˆfeeˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆBrookLink,ˆinˆtheˆUSˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆAnyˆotherˆATMˆinˆtheˆUSˆ|ˆ$2.50ˆ|ˆ|ˆATMsˆoutsideˆtheˆUSˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆEveryˆout-of-networkˆwithdrawalˆisˆchargedˆtheˆfee.ˆToˆavoidˆit,ˆuseˆaˆBrookLinkˆATM.ˆ##ˆSurchargesˆATMˆownersˆoutsideˆBrookLinkˆcanˆaddˆtheirˆownˆsurchargeˆonˆtopˆofˆourˆfee.ˆTheˆATMˆshowsˆitˆonˆscreenˆbeforeˆyouˆconfirm.ˆ##ˆDailyˆlimitˆYouˆcanˆwithdrawˆupˆtoˆ$500ˆaˆdayˆonˆBasic.ˆ##ˆWhereˆfeesˆshowˆupˆAnyˆTallowbrookˆATMˆfeeˆappearsˆasˆitsˆownˆlineˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeed,ˆrightˆafterˆtheˆwithdrawal,ˆsoˆyouˆcanˆalwaysˆseeˆwhatˆyouˆpaidˆusˆandˆwhatˆtheˆATMˆownerˆcharged.ˆTheˆapp'sˆATMˆmapˆshowsˆtheˆnearestˆBrookLinkˆATMs.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="fees-schedule-basic-v2">
BasicˆplanˆfeeˆscheduleˆHereˆisˆeveryˆfeeˆthatˆcanˆapplyˆtoˆaˆBasicˆaccount,ˆeffectiveˆMarchˆ1,ˆ2026.ˆFeesˆareˆtakenˆfromˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆwhenˆthey'reˆchargedˆandˆshowˆupˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeedˆwithˆtheˆwordˆ"Fee".ˆ|ˆFeeˆ|ˆAmountˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆMonthlyˆfeeˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOut-of-networkˆATMˆwithdrawalˆ|ˆ$2.50ˆ|ˆ|ˆInternationalˆATMˆwithdrawalˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆForeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆ|ˆ3%ˆ|ˆ|ˆCardˆreplacementˆ|ˆ$5.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆExpeditedˆcardˆshippingˆ|ˆ$25.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆdomesticˆwireˆ|ˆ$25.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆnotˆavailableˆ|ˆ|ˆIncomingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆ$10.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆCashˆdepositˆatˆaˆretailˆstoreˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆ##ˆDetailsˆBrookLinkˆATMsˆareˆalwaysˆfree.ˆTheˆout-of-networkˆfeeˆappliesˆtoˆeveryˆwithdrawalˆatˆanyˆotherˆATMˆinˆtheˆUS.ˆOutgoingˆinternationalˆwiresˆaren'tˆavailableˆonˆthisˆplan.ˆNoˆplanˆhasˆoverdraftˆfees,ˆreturnedˆtransferˆfeesˆorˆinactivityˆfees.ˆTheˆmonthlyˆfeeˆisˆchargedˆonˆyourˆbillingˆdateˆandˆisn'tˆprorated.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
